variants.headline: Union calls a strike
variants.body: The union {name} has called a strike. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: A call to withhold labour
variants.body: A strike has been called by the union {name}. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: Work becomes the subject of a strike call
variants.body: The union {name} has issued a call for strike action. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.
